A student moves a magnet into a coil, as shown. The voltmeter measures the magnitude of the
electromotive force (e.m.f.) induced in the coil.
coil

magnet

Which quantity does not affect the magnitude of the induced e.m.f.?
A
the number of turns per unit length in the coil
B
the polarity of the magnet
C
the speed of the magnet
D
the strength of the magnet

options.label: A
options.text: the number of turns per unit length in the coil
